scripts.dev: pnpm --filter backend... run build && pnpm run watch
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter backend... run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter backend... run build && vitest run --coverage
scripts.test:shard: pnpm --filter backend... run build && VITEST_SHARD=1 vitest run --coverage --reporter=blob --reporter=default
scripts.test:merge: pnpm --filter backend... run build && vitest run --merge-reports --coverage
scripts.test:browser: pnpm --filter backend... run build && playwright test
